title: IMM-based Multiple Object Tracking using a State Prediction Neural Network
abstract: arXiv:2609.13307v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Object tracking is essential for autonomous vehicles to avoid obstacles and plan routes. Radar maintains detection performance even in adverse weather and can measure relative velocity through the Doppler effect, making it well suited for object tracking. In this paper, we propose a data-driven state PRedictor-based Interacting Multiple Model tracking method (PR-IMM) that improves nonlinear object-motion representation while preserving the stability and interpretability of physics-based motion models. The proposed method employs a transformer-based PRediction model (PR) that incorporates radar Doppler measurements to predict object displacement. The PR model is integrated into the IMM as a mode alongside the CV, CA, and CT motion models, and their prior positions are dynamically combined according to the mode probabilities. translated_title: 基于状态预测神经网络的交互多模型多目标跟踪
translated_abstract: 目标跟踪对于自动驾驶车辆避开障碍物和规划路线至关重要。雷达即使在恶劣天气下也能保持检测性能，并可通过多普勒效应测量相对速度，因此非常适合用于目标跟踪。本文提出了一种基于数据驱动状态预测器的交互多模型跟踪方法（PR-IMM），该方法在保持基于物理的运动模型的稳定性和可解释性的同时，改进了对非线性物体运动的表征能力。所提出的方法采用基于Transformer的预测模型（PR），融合雷达多普勒测量数据来预测物体位移。PR模型作为一种模式与CV、CA和CT运动模型一起集成到IMM框架中，并根据模式概率对各模型的先验位置进行动态融合。实验结果表明，PR-IMM相比IMM将位置估计误差降低了57.3%，相比基线方法降低了16.5%。
tldr: 提出PR-IMM方法，将融合雷达多普勒测量的Transformer状态预测神经网络作为新模式嵌入交互多模型跟踪框架，在保持物理模型可解释性的同时，将位置估计误差较IMM降低57.3%。
en_tdlr: PR-IMM integrates a transformer-based state prediction neural network with radar Doppler measurements as a new mode within the Interacting Multiple Model tracking framework, reducing position-estimation error by 57.3% over IMM while preserving the stability and interpretability of physics-based motion models.
